subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does a concrete ACP protocol trace demonstrate that current OpenClaw can execute a command before its permission result, and which component owns that ordering guarantee?
rationale: The issue alleges a security-boundary bypass, but the supplied terminology and proposed queue do not map clearly to current OpenClaw source; ACP owner and dependency-contract verification are required before public closure or implementation.

options.title: Request protocol reproduction
options.body: Ask for the affected versions, token-limit source, exact permission payload and chunk sequence, timestamps, and a redacted execution trace before selecting a repair.

options.title: Route as confirmed security defect
options.body: If an ACP owner can reproduce execution before permission resolution, handle it through the repository security process and fix the component that owns the ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Request protocol reproduction
